name: NetworkManager (Wi‑Fi, Ethernet, VPN)

1.how: nmcli -t dev status | dev wifi list | dev wifi connect <ssid> password <pw> | con up|down id <name> | con add type vpn … | radio wifi on|off | general status
1.notes: Everything the settings panel does. -t gives machine-readable output.

1.how: org.freedesktop.NetworkManager on the system bus (/org/freedesktop/NetworkManager): Devices, ActiveConnections, PropertiesChanged signals

2.notes: Prefer nmcli; it writes these safely.

quirks: Passwords for saved networks live in NetworkManager's keyring-backed store; nmcli con up reuses them without asking.
